---
title: "Data"
---

Everything below is anonymized and published under the assumption you'll want
to play with it.

| File | What's in it |
|---|---|
| [`responses_anon.csv`](docs_data/responses_anon.csv) | One row per consenting participant, hashed ID, all survey answers |
| [`taste_coords.csv`](docs_data/taste_coords.csv) | PC1/PC2 coordinates, cluster, neighborhood label |
| [`taste_terms.json`](docs_data/taste_terms.json) | Top positive/negative tf-idf loadings per component |
| [`neighbors.csv`](docs_data/neighbors.csv) | Each person's three nearest taste twins, by cosine similarity |
| [`playlist_tracks.csv`](docs_data/playlist_tracks.csv) | Matched Spotify tracks with album, year, popularity |
| [`apple_tracks.csv`](docs_data/apple_tracks.csv) | The same picks resolved in the Apple Music catalog |
| [`summary.json`](docs_data/summary.json) | Headline counts used on the homepage |

```{python}
#| label: preview
#| echo: true
#| code-summary: "Load the published data"
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

p = Path("docs_data/responses_anon.csv")
if p.exists():
    df = pd.read_csv(p)
    print(f"{len(df)} participants, {len(df.columns)} columns")
    display(df.head())
else:
    print("No responses yet. Run: python scripts/make_sample_data.py --n 42 "
          "&& python scripts/run_all.py --no-fetch")
```

```{python}
#| label: coords
#| code-summary: "Peek at the taste-map coordinates"
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

p = Path("docs_data/taste_coords.csv")
if p.exists():
    display(pd.read_csv(p).head(10))
else:
    print("Taste map has not been generated yet.")
```
